children: Alibaba Group, the Chinese commerce and cloud-AI company

, outlined its full-stack AI push on September 22, with U.S. shares at $108.43, up approximately 0.6% at 10.30am ET on September 30. The plan connects models, proprietary chips, AI agents and cloud infrastructure. The valuation snapshot puts shares 10.85% below the $121.62 GF Value estimatea potential valuation cushion, provided the business delivers.

The hardware timetable gives investors something concrete to watch. Alibaba says its Zhenwu V900 accelerator carries 216 gigabytes of memory, delivers 1,200 gigabytes per second of inter-chip bandwidth and offers three times its predecessor's performance. Commercial release is scheduled for the first quarter of 2027. Meanwhile, the company's roadmap targets five trillion to 10 trillion parameters for future Qwen models. Bigger specifications raise the stakes. They still need paying customers.

Controlling more of the AI stack could help Alibaba keep more customer spending and reduce reliance on outside suppliers. It also puts chip execution, data-center utilization and investment discipline on the same balance sheet. Management targets more than 20 gigawatts of global cloud data-center capacity by 2032. That is a huge buildout. The investor test is whether demand produces attractive returns, rather than simply filling capacity.

title: Alibaba Stocks Rise as Ten-Trillion-Parameter Plan Expands AI Bet
